Lemon Squeezy by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Lemon Squeezy, your coastal oasis in Seacrest, tucked between Rosemary Beach and Watersound. This immaculate 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom villa is the perfect setting for your next 30A beach getaway. Just steps from your door, enjoy the private beach access to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf! For a change of scenery, The Cottages at Camp Creek features a spacious community pool and inviting hot tub. Enjoy private beach access, granting you exclusive entry to some of the most pristine and sought-after beaches along 30A. Ready for an adventure? Go on a ride with one of the 3 complimentary bikes. You’ll love exploring nearby Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Big Chill, each offering unique dining, shopping, and events. After a day in the sun, relax on a private balcony with an evening cocktail, or cheer on your favorite sports team on the large TV. Just four blocks west of Watersound Parkway, Lemon Squeezy's prime location in Seacrest ensures you're close to all the 30A attractions you desire. Book your stay at Lemon Squeezy and let the charm of 30A and the comfort of this coastal villa whisk you away into a world of relaxation and adventure. Welcome!

Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 250 steps to the beach (Private Deeded Access) - 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 1,590 sq ft - Community pool with hot tub - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; private balcony - 2 twins and a full in 2nd floor guest room, private bath - Queen in 3rd floor guest room; private bath; private balcony - Living room features full sleeper sofa Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
